gate_coh.rule: at least 0.85 of the same_doc sets labelled coherent and 0.85 of the mixed sets labelled mixed, declines in the denominator (SPEC_instruments §5.3; the same_doc control adopted after E0b)

R3.rule: D = mean over poles with sets of both kinds of (driver share - clusterer share), a pole's share the mean of [labelled coherent] over its sets; bootstrap over poles, 2,000 draws, seed 0, 95% percentile; interval above +0.10 -> driver sets more readable, entirely below -0.10 -> less readable, otherwise not separated (SPEC_instruments §5.4 R3)

driver_size_tercile_cuts.rule: t0: n <= cut 1; t1: cut 1 < n <= cut 2; t2: n > cut 2 (the V cluster's uncapped size)

identity.what: driver sets whose 12 read passages equal a clusterer set's: this batch's label against the bank's label on the same request text

predictions.row: coherent share, driver sets (§5.5, stated before E0 in the job unit)
